text: Cells in this field carry CD3 and CD4 on their surface and secrete cytokines after contact with antigen-presenting cells. A few large phagocytic cells sit at the edge of the field.
Small round cells with little cytoplasm make antibodies after activation; the slide also shows scattered neutrophils with multi-lobed nuclei.
The section shows flattened keratinocytes in the outer layer and branching astrocytes in the tissue below; no immune cells are visible.
Cytotoxic T cells and NK cells cluster around the infected cells, and monocytes are entering from a nearby vessel.
